plans.fair_use: The GLM Coding Plan is strictly limited to use within officially supported tools and products.
plans.estimate_assumption: STANDARD: 1 request/prompt/message = 1 agentic model call of 20,000 input tokens (18,000 cache-read + 2,000 uncached) + 1,500 output = 21,500 tokens. Window plans: 4 usable 5h windows/day x 30 days = 120 windows/month, then capped by weekly cap x 30/7 and by any monthly cap (whichever binds first). Dollar-pool plans: pool / blended reference rate for the same token mix at Claude Sonnet 5.5 list ($2 in / $0.20 cache-read / $10 out per Mtok) = $1.0512/Mtok. Z.AI credits per call (GLM-5.3, peak rate) = (2000x6.9 + 18000x1.7 + 1500x24)/10,000 = 8.04 credits; off-peak (all hours except Mon-Fri 14:00-18:00 SGT) is 50% -> up to 2x tokens. Binding cap: weekly.
plans.notes: Official estimate table: 96% cache GLM-5.3 Lite = see docs (Lite 50-99M tokens/week). Weekly cap binds at 4 windows/day (5h cap alone would allow 6x more). Off-peak doubles tokens -> ~$0.079/Mtok. Promo 2026-09-25..10-07 all-day off-peak. API-equivalent at GLM-5.3 list ($1.4/$0.26/$4.4): ~$75/mo.
